headline: Rightmove Raises 2026 EPS Growth Forecast to at Least 7%
summary: Rightmove increased its earnings per share growth forecast for 2026 to at least 7%, according to an Investing.com report.
why: Guidance upgrades from major online platform operators signal operational resilience and revenue growth visibility in digital advertising and classifieds markets.

impacts.name: Rightmove
impacts.why: Rightmove raised its EPS growth forecast to at least 7%.
